title: 自动移液器
source_doc: course/MIT Digital Lab Techniques Manual/13_Automatic Pipet.md
author_source: project/MIT Digital Lab Techniques Manual/13_Automatic Pipet/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一支可调式移液器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up an adjustable air-displacement pipette with a yellow plastic tip and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课学移液器的正确用法。

shots.scene: 选规格、设体积、吸放液、校准四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: three pipettes of different sizes, a dial window, a tip dipping into liquid, and a balance. No people.
shots.narration: 选规格、设体积、吸放液、校准，一个不落。

shots.scene: 阿杰斜拿着移液器，按钮啪地弹回，液体冲进吸杆
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a pipette at a steep angle and lets the plunger snap back; liquid splashes up toward the shaft.
shots.narration: 阿杰移液，按钮一松啪地弹回来。

shots.scene: 阿杰把带液的移液器平放在台面
shots.prompt_en: The young male student lays the pipette flat on the bench with liquid still in the tip.
shots.narration: 还把带液的移液器平放在桌上。

shots.scene: 小研拿起移液器，摇头指着吸杆
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks up the pipette, shakes her head and points at the shaft.
shots.narration: 小研说：液体进了吸杆，移液器就伤了。

shots.scene: 玻璃移液管和小烧杯里的少量液体
shots.prompt_en: A glass pipette with a rubber bulb next to a tiny amount of liquid in a small vial, with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 一毫升以下，玻璃移液管不够准。

shots.scene: 移液器吸起一点点液体，勾号
shots.prompt_en: A pipette with a small tip drawing up a tiny volume of red liquid, with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 生物、生化实验，常用自动移液器。

shots.scene: 剖面动画：按下按钮，活塞下移排出空气
shots.prompt_en: Cutaway animation of a pipette: the plunger is pressed and the piston moves down pushing air out. No people.
shots.narration: 按下按钮，活塞把空气推出去。

shots.scene: 吸头浸入液体，松开按钮，液体被吸入
shots.prompt_en: The tip dips into red liquid; the plunger is released and liquid rises into the tip. No people.
shots.narration: 吸头浸入液体，慢松按钮，液体被吸上来。

shots.scene: 再按按钮，液体排进另一个容器
shots.prompt_en: The plunger is pressed again and the liquid flows out into an empty container. No people.
shots.narration: 再慢慢按下，液体就排进新容器。

shots.scene: 靶心图标：箭头贴近中心
shots.prompt_en: A target icon with darts landing close to the center. No people.
shots.narration: 准确度：排出的量接近设定值。

shots.scene: 靶上几支箭聚在一起
shots.prompt_en: A target icon with several darts tightly grouped together. No people.
shots.narration: 精密度：每次都一样，重复性好。

shots.scene: 移液器结构示意：按钮、退吸头钮、旋钮、显示窗、吸杆
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a pipette with arrows to the plunger button, the tip ejector button, the volume knob, the volume window and the plastic shaft. No people.
shots.narration: 按钮、退吸头钮、调节旋钮、显示窗、吸杆。

shots.scene: 一排粗细不同的移液器挂在支架上
shots.prompt_en: A row of five pipettes of different sizes hanging on a white stand. No people.
shots.narration: 移液器有好几种规格。

shots.scene: 按钮顶端特写，上面一个圆形标记
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the top of a plunger button with a colored round badge. No people.
shots.narration: 按钮上的数字，是它的最大量程。

shots.scene: 二十微升规格的量程条
shots.prompt_en: A volume bar from zero up to a top mark for a small pipette. No people.
shots.narration: 二十微升的那支，能设零到二十微升。

shots.scene: 量程条低端标红，误差线很长
shots.prompt_en: A volume bar with its low end shaded red and long error bars above it. No people.
shots.narration: 量程低端误差大，不建议用。

shots.scene: 各规格推荐范围的条形图
shots.prompt_en: A bar chart of six pipette sizes, each with its recommended range shaded and a small marker at its lowest recommended volume. No people.
shots.narration: 每种规格，都有推荐的最小体积。

shots.scene: 最大一支的量程条，低端标记高亮
shots.prompt_en: The largest pipette's range bar, with the marker at its lowest recommended volume highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 最大一支，推荐最小一百微升。

shots.scene: 空白任务卡上一个移液的图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank task card with a pipette icon and a droplet. No people.
shots.narration: 比如要移一百五十三点五微升。

shots.scene: 两支移液器的量程条，一支打勾一支打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two pipettes with volume bars: the target sits near the top of the smaller one with a check mark, and near the bottom of the larger one with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 两百和一千的都够，选两百那支。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着打勾的那支
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the pipette with the check mark.
shots.narration: 目标值别落在量程低端。

shots.scene: 蓝、黄、白三盒吸头
shots.prompt_en: Three racks of disposable tips: large blue, medium yellow and small white. No people.
shots.narration: 吸头有大蓝、中黄、小白三种。

shots.scene: 移液器和对应颜色的吸头连线
shots.prompt_en: Lines connect each pipette to the matching tip color. No people.
shots.narration: 规格配对，才不漏液、才准。

shots.scene: 显示窗三位数字特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a three-digit volume window on a pipette, digits shown as blank wheels with stripes. No people.
shots.narration: 小规格的，显示多少就是多少。

shots.scene: 大规格显示窗旁边一个乘以十的图标
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the volume window of the largest pipette with a times ten icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 一千微升那支，读数要乘以十。

shots.scene: 旋钮转过目标约三分之一圈
shots.prompt_en: A gloved thumb turns the volume knob a third of a turn past the target mark. No people.
shots.narration: 先转过目标值约三分之一圈。

shots.scene: 再慢慢回调到目标
shots.prompt_en: The knob is turned slowly back down and stops exactly at the target mark. No people.
shots.narration: 再慢慢往回调到目标值。

shots.scene: 齿轮间隙示意，向下箭头打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of two gears with a small gap; a downward arrow has a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 总是从大往小调，消除机械回差。

shots.scene: 旋钮转过最大值的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the volume knob forced past the maximum mark, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别转过最大量程，超量程的换大规格。

shots.scene: 台面摆着移液器、吸头盒、试管架、新容器、擦拭纸和废液杯
shots.prompt_en: On a bench: a set pipette, a tip rack, a tube rack, a new container, a plain tissue and a waste beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 备好移液器、吸头、架子、新容器。

shots.scene: 擦拭纸和废液杯高亮
shots.prompt_en: The tissue and the waste beaker glow. No people.
shots.narration: 还有擦拭纸和废物容器。

shots.scene: 吸杆压进吸头并轻轻旋转
shots.prompt_en: A pipette shaft is pressed firmly into a yellow tip in the rack with a slight twist.
shots.narration: 吸杆用力压进吸头，轻轻一转。

shots.scene: 吸头与吸杆密封处特写，勾号
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the tight seal between tip and shaft with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 装紧密封，才不会漏。

shots.scene: 每个样品配一个新吸头的示意
shots.prompt_en: Three sample tubes, each paired with its own fresh tip by arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 每个样品，都用新的无菌吸头。

shots.scene: 吸头碰到台面的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a pipette tip touching the bench surface, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 吸头除了样品，什么都别碰。

shots.scene: 拇指按下按钮到第一档
shots.prompt_en: A gloved thumb presses the plunger down to the first stop where resistance is felt.
shots.narration: 按到有阻力的地方，就是第一档。

shots.scene: 竖直持握，吸头浸入红色液体
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the pipette straight up and dips the tip into red liquid in a vial.
shots.narration: 竖直拿着，吸头浸进样品。

shots.scene: 拇指慢慢松开，液体吸入吸头
shots.prompt_en: The thumb releases slowly and red liquid rises into the tip.
shots.narration: 慢慢松开按钮，液体吸进来。

shots.scene: 钟表图标停顿一两秒
shots.prompt_en: A small clock icon ticks for a moment beside the filled tip. No people.
shots.narration: 停一两秒，大体积或粘稠的多等会儿。

shots.scene: 擦拭纸轻擦吸头外壁
shots.prompt_en: A plain tissue gently wipes the outside of the tip.
shots.narration: 取出来，擦掉吸头外壁的液体。

shots.scene: 吸头贴着新试管内壁
shots.prompt_en: The tip touches the inner wall of a new tube in a rack.
shots.narration: 吸头贴住新容器内壁。

shots.scene: 按到第一档，停几秒
shots.prompt_en: The thumb presses slowly to the first stop and pauses while the liquid flows out.
shots.narration: 慢按到第一档，停几秒让液体流完。

shots.scene: 再按到第二档排尽
shots.prompt_en: The thumb pushes on to the second stop and the last drop is blown out.
shots.narration: 再按到第二档，排出余液。

shots.scene: 按住按钮，吸头沿壁滑出
shots.prompt_en: With the plunger held down, the tip slides up along the tube wall and out.
shots.narration: 按住别松，吸头沿壁滑出，再松手。

shots.scene: 按退吸头钮，吸头掉进废物盒
shots.prompt_en: A thumb presses the ejector button and the used tip drops into a waste box.
shots.narration: 用完按退吸头钮，弹进废物容器。

shots.scene: 三个样品，三个新吸头
shots.prompt_en: Three tubes of different colored samples, each with a new tip. No people.
shots.narration: 准则一：换样品就换吸头，防污染。

shots.scene: 新吸头吸入溶液再排进废液杯
shots.prompt_en: A new tip draws up solution and expels it into a waste beaker.
shots.narration: 准则二：新吸头先吸一次排掉，预润洗。

shots.scene: 吸头内壁形成液膜的示意
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a tip with a thin liquid film coating its inner wall, then a full accurate volume. No people.
shots.narration: 内壁先挂上液膜，后面的量才准。

shots.scene: 吸头浸得太深，液体顶到吸杆的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tip plunged too deep with liquid reaching the shaft, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 准则三：浸太深，液体会进吸杆。

shots.scene: 浸得太浅，吸进空气的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tip barely touching the surface sucking in air, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 浸太浅，会吸进空气。

shots.scene: 三种吸头各自合适的浸入深度
shots.prompt_en: Three tips dipped to slightly different shallow depths below the liquid surface, each with a small depth marker. No people.
shots.narration: 一般只浸入液面下几毫米。

shots.scene: 吸头里有气泡
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a filled tip with an air bubble gap in the liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 吸头里有气泡？

shots.scene: 排回废液杯，放慢重吸
shots.prompt_en: The liquid is expelled into a waste beaker and drawn up again slowly at the right depth. No people.
shots.narration: 排进废液杯，查深度，放慢重吸。

shots.scene: 换一个新吸头
shots.prompt_en: The tip is ejected and a fresh tip is attached. No people.
shots.narration: 还有气泡，就换新吸头。

shots.scene: 按钮猛地弹回的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a plunger snapping up with liquid splashing into the shaft, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 准则四：按钮慢慢松，别让它弹回。

shots.scene: 擦拭纸碰到吸头口，样品被吸走
shots.prompt_en: A tissue touches the tip opening and a red stain wicks into the paper, with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 准则五：擦外壁，别碰吸头口。

shots.scene: 移液器倾斜角度示意，二十度内打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a pipette tilted within a small angle from vertical with a green check, and a steeper angle with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 准则六：带液时倾斜别超过二十度。

shots.scene: 带液平放的移液器被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a pipette lying flat with liquid in the tip, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能平放。

shots.scene: 节拍器和四个相同的动作图标
shots.prompt_en: A metronome icon next to four identical pipetting motion icons in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 按放速度、力度，每次一个样。

shots.scene: 浸入深度和角度都相同的三次操作
shots.prompt_en: Three side-by-side pipetting views with the same depth and the same slight angle. No people.
shots.narration: 浸入深度、持握角度，也保持一致。

shots.scene: 水滴和砝码，一毫升等于一克的示意
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a one milliliter droplet equal to a one gram weight. No people.
shots.narration: 定期校准：先按密度算出一毫升多重。

shots.scene: 分析天平上的小瓶去皮，移液器移入
shots.prompt_en: A small vial is tared on an analytical balance and a pipette set near its maximum dispenses water into it.
shots.narration: 天平上去皮，设在量程上端移液称重。

shots.scene: 六次读数，算平均和偏差
shots.prompt_en: Six blank reading cards lined up with an average line and a spread bracket. No people.
shots.narration: 重复六次，算平均值和标准偏差。

shots.scene: 再设在量程下端重复
shots.prompt_en: The pipette dial turned near its low end and the weighing repeated. No people.
shots.narration: 再在量程下端测一遍，偏了就调整。

shots.scene: 吸好液体的移液器竖直拿着，钟表
shots.prompt_en: A pipette with a freshly pre-rinsed filled tip held vertically beside a clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 检漏：新吸头预润洗，吸液竖直等。

shots.scene: 吸头口出现一滴液滴
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a drop forming at the tip opening, with a warning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 吸头口冒出液滴，就是漏了。

shots.scene: O形圈磨损的放大示意
shots.prompt_en: Magnified diagram of a worn rubber O-ring inside the shaft and a loose tip. No people.
shots.narration: 可能是吸头不配或密封圈磨损。

shots.scene: 冷温度计和热温度计
shots.prompt_en: Two thermometer icons, one very cold and one very hot, beside a pipette. No people.
shots.narration: 太冷太热的样品，会让移液不准。

shots.scene: 腐蚀性象形图和移液器
shots.prompt_en: A corrosion hazard pictogram next to a pipette with damaged seals. No people.
shots.narration: 酸和腐蚀液会腐蚀活塞和密封件。

shots.scene: 老李拆开移液器擦洗零件
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer disassembles a pipette and wipes the piston and seals with a tissue.
shots.narration: 移过之后马上拆开检查清洗。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现节拍器、新吸头和天平图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a metronome, a fresh tip and a balance.
shots.narration: 动作一致、新吸头预润洗、定期校准。

shots.scene: 移液器摔落的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a pipette falling to the floor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 移液器精密易坏，别摔。

shots.scene: 液体进吸杆的两种情况被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out: a snapping plunger and a pipette lying flat. No people.
shots.narration: 别让液体进吸杆，避开极端温度和腐蚀液。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现三支移液器和三色吸头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three pipettes and boxes of blue, yellow and white tips.
shots.narration: 选对规格和吸头，从大往小调体积。

shots.scene: 第一档、第二档图示
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a pipette button with a first stop and a second stop. No people.
shots.narration: 第一档吸，贴壁放，第二档排尽。

shots.scene: 竖直、浅浸、慢松三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an upright pipette, a shallow tip immersion and a slowly rising button. No people.
shots.narration: 竖直浅浸，慢松按钮，别平放。

shots.scene: 天平和液滴图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an analytical balance and a single drop at a tip. No people.
shots.narration: 定期称量校准，二十秒检漏。

shots.scene: 新吸头和温度计、腐蚀液图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fresh tip, a thermometer and a corrosive liquid bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 一样一换吸头，避开极端温度和腐蚀液。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着移液器挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a pipette and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 移得准，做得稳，下次见！
